Polynomial Regression.

Fits one numeric predictor as powers from degree one through the selected degree, then appends Float32 prediction and residual columns.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Category | [Analytics](../categories/analytics.md) |
| Status | Runs |
| Also read from graphs as | `PolynomialRegressionNode` |
| Search words | polynomial, regression, curve, fit |

## Inputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Data** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Table containing one numeric predictor and a numeric target column |

## Outputs

| Pin | Type | Required | Connections | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| **Fitted** | Dataset | Yes | 1 | Input table plus Float32 prediction and residual columns |
| **Model** | Parameters | No | 1 | Reusable fitted polynomial-regression artifact |

## Settings

| Group | Setting | Key | Type | Default | Allowed values | Read by | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Columns | Predictor column | `feature_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Single numeric predictor column. Required. |
| Columns | Target column | `target_col` | Text | (empty) |   | The run | Numeric response column. Required. |
| Fit Options | Degree | `degree` | Integer | `2` | `1-6` | The run | Highest polynomial power, 1 to 6; requires at least degree plus two rows. |

**Read by** says whether a run uses the setting (**The run**) or only the editor, a dialog or a view (**The editor only**).
